name: Cascade Station
summary: Sprawling shopping center featuring big-box stores, casual restaurants & familiar chain retailers.
demographics: Cascade Station primarily attracts middle to upper-middle income households from Northeast Portland and surrounding suburban communities, with a significant portion of visitors being professionals aged 25-54 and young families. The trade area benefits from its proximity to the airport and major employment centers, drawing a mix of local residents seeking convenient shopping options and business travelers. Typical visitors include dual-income households with moderate to high disposable income who appreciate the lifestyle center format and variety of national chain retailers and casual dining options.
description: Cascade Station is a distinctive outdoor shopping and entertainment destination located in Portland, Oregon, strategically positioned near the Portland International Airport. This modern lifestyle center offers a convenient mix of retail, dining, and entertainment options that cater to both local residents and travelers. The center features a variety of national retailers and popular restaurant chains in an open-air format that embraces the Pacific Northwest lifestyle. With its accessible location along NE Cascades Parkway, Cascade Station serves as a regional retail hub for Northeast Portland, providing easy access for shoppers from throughout the metro area. The development has become an important commercial node in the Portland area, offering a contemporary shopping experience with ample parking and a walkable layout.
